headline: Ibovespa Falls for Sixth Session as US Dollar Hits Yearly High in Brazil
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa dropped 1.42% to 165,528.92 points in its sixth consecutive decline, while the US dollar closed at R$ 5.4872, its highest level of the year.
why: The Ibovespa is the benchmark stock index of Latin America's largest economy, and persistent domestic fiscal concerns drive capital flight into the US dollar.
why_moved: Deteriorating domestic fiscal expectations and post-election pressures drove investors out of Brazilian equities and into the US dollar.
